titles.english: It Comes Ryuuu And It Goes Kyuuu
titles.native: りゅーーっときてきゅーーっ!!!

description: Fully CG animated music video for the song It Comes Ryuuu And It Goes Kyuuu by UMISEA. The group comprises of Minato Aqua and Houshou Marine of hololive JP, together with Ninomae Ina’nis and Gawr Gura of hololive EN. This hologra styled video and eccentric track debuts the newest member to join the ocean-themed unit: Sakamata Chloe.
